content: robosuite==1.4.0 exists on PyPI (confirmed: available versions include 1.4.0, 1.4.1, 1.5.x). mujoco==2.3.7 exists on PyPI. gym==0.25.2 exists on PyPI. LIBERO requires robosuite 1.4.0 — robosuite 1.4.x migrated to dm-control MuJoCo bindings (no mujoco-py). Install order: (1) system apt packages for EGL, (2) mujoco==2.3.7, (3) gym==0.25.2, (4) robosuite==1.4.0, (5) pip install -e LIBERO, (6) remaining deps. Do NOT use mujoco-py — robosuite 1.4 uses the native mujoco Python package.
